repos_data.description: Read ISO 20022 camt Bank-to-Customer Statements (camt.052/053/054) and generate validated reversing entries by return reason code such as AC04 Closed Account. Core library with a Click CLI and FastAPI REST API.

Parse & reconcile ISO 20022 camt.053 bank-to-customer statements from Claude Desktop, Cursor & other MCP clients — 19 tools, CBPR+/HVPS+ readiness, SLSA-L3 provenance. Part of the ISO 20022 MCP Suite.
